evals.prompt: /handoff   (my last response ended with a numbered list: 1. fix the stale slug check in validate.ps1, 2. re-run the manifest generator, 3. open a PR. Go do all that in a new session.)
evals.expected_output: A prompt file under docs/PROMPTS/ in the main checkout, ordered by dependency, handed to the dispatch sub-skill for worktree creation and launch.
expectations: Prompt file is written to docs/PROMPTS/<date>-<slug>.md in the main checkout, not inside a worktree
Tasks follow the recovered decision list in dependency order, with the ordering rationale stated (fix the rule before re-running the generator)
Prompt contains hard constraints first, State already established, What we tried / dead ends, Tasks, Finishing, Delegation, Delegation logging and Reporting sections
Every state claim in the prompt is tagged [V] or [?]
Prompt says the worktree and branch already exist and must not be re-created
Prompt instructs model: "haiku" explicitly for mechanical subagents and states which model was pinned and why
Prompt requires the end-of-session delegation tally tagged with -PromptPath as the final step, using absolute script paths
Launch is delegated to dispatch; handoff does not itself run new-task-worktree.ps1 or launch-claude-session.ps1

evals.prompt: /dispatch-session-prompt Rename the foo() helper to bar() across the 40 files under src/ in repo X, update tests, and open a PR.
evals.expected_output: A prompt file built from the supplied scope (no recovery from prior conversation), handed to dispatch.
expectations: Scope is parsed from the invocation argument, not from a prior decision list
Ambiguity (e.g. whether to rename in docs) is settled via AskUserQuestion before writing, not passed downstream
Prompt file contains all required sections including a What we tried / dead ends section ("None - first attempt" if empty)
State claims such as the file count are tagged [V] when measured this session and [?] otherwise
Questions about the handoff itself are resolved and encoded as constraints, not left as tasks
Launch is handed to dispatch

evals.prompt: /continue-new-session  - I want to paste it into Codex. (Last recap ended: 'Next: implement P2-T3 for auth-flow, use TDD.')
evals.expected_output: A single fenced markdown block printed to chat for Codex; no file written, nothing launched.
expectations: Names Codex as the target CLI and refers to AGENTS.md rather than CLAUDE.md
Output is exactly one fenced markdown code block followed by one sentence telling the user to paste it
Recommended action is taken from the recap (implement P2-T3 for auth-flow, TDD) without re-deriving from project state
Referenced docs paths are verified to exist; missing ones are noted, not emitted as broken references
Contains no unresolved {placeholder} text
Contains state claims tagged [V]/[?] and a What we tried / dead ends section
Writes no prompt file, launches no terminal, and does not call dispatch or any launcher script
Does not modify files under docs/

evals.prompt: I need to migrate ~200 scripts off the deprecated Get-Foo helper across many sessions. Set up a chained handoff so each session does one chunk and hands off the next.
evals.expected_output: A self-similar chain prompt carrying a sequence number, a discovery command, one capped batch, and an instruction to re-emit itself.
expectations: Prompt carries a sequence number (Handoff N) that is to be incremented on re-emit
Prompt embeds a discovery command (e.g. a grep for Get-Foo) as the single source of truth and says to re-run it fresh each session
Prompt defines a batch-selection heuristic with a size cap of roughly 20-30 targets and one PR per batch
Execution recipe requires per-file judgment and forbids blind sed/find-replace
Prompt requires prepending an entry to a progress log and notes recurring failure modes at the top
Prompt instructs the next session to repeat the process and re-emit this same prompt with only state and sequence number updated, with a stop condition when discovery returns zero
Prompt includes What we tried / dead ends and [V]/[?]-tagged state
No separate central master plan is created

evals.prompt: (Mid-session, context is very long after several compactions; the user has not asked for a handoff.)
evals.expected_output: A one-sentence offer to hand off; no prompt file written and nothing launched.
expectations: Offers a handoff in a single sentence
Does not write a prompt file or launch anything without the user's go-ahead
